title: Outsized Stock Buys: GE, GM, Apple, Facebook
text:
Outsized Stock Buys: GE, GM, Apple, Facebook The Canadian Pension Plan more than quadrupled its stake in GE in the fourth quarter. By March 9, 2018 8:31 a.m. ET By Ed Lin March 9, 2018 8:31 a.m. ET 
“We invest not for the quarter but for the quarter century,” the Canadian Pension Plan Investment Boardsays on its site. 
The pension’s board however had no problem with making stock trades in the fourth quarter that seem a bit eager for that long timeline, including buying millions of shares General Electric (ticker: GE), General Motors (GM), Facebook (FB), Apple (AAPL) and JPMorgan Chase (JPM).
